Bonsai 4B - Bonsai - docs.prismml.com
sources.snippet: Bonsai 4B targets edge deployments where the bigger Bonsai models don't fit or where you need headroom for other workloads. At 0.57 GB (1-bit), the weights are small enough to power applications on wearables, and mobile devices.

sources.title: Announcing 1-bit Bonsai: The First Commercially Viable 1-bit LLMs - PrismML
sources.snippet: The 1-bit Bonsai 8B, along with its smaller sister models 1-bit Bonsai 1.7B and 4B, dramatically moves the Pareto frontier (of intelligence vs model size) to the left.
